account.title: My account
account.name: Name
account.mismatch: The new passwords are not the same.
account.changed: Password changed. Other sessions were logged out.

users.title: Users
users.sub: Admins manage everything. Customers only see mail for the domains linked to them.
users.name: Name
users.password_hint: Leave empty to generate one. At least 10 characters.
users.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.generated: User created. Give them this password; it is shown only once:
users.delete_confirm: Delete {{email}}? They can no longer sign in.
users.domains_hint: Customers only see mail from and to these domains.
users.no_domains: No domains yet. Add domains under Domains first.

trace.title: Mail trace
trace.sub: Find any message and see straight away whether it arrived, and if not, why.
trace.search: Search by sender, recipient, message ID, queue ID or server
trace.empty: No mail yet in this period. As soon as mail flows through Mailfilter it shows up here.
trace.no_results: Nothing found. Try a shorter search or a longer period.
trace.q_deleted: Blocked and deleted from quarantine by {{who}} on {{when}}.
trace.q_learned_ham: The spam filter learned this is good mail.
trace.q_learned_spam: The spam filter learned this is spam.
trace.who_sender: Who can fix it: the sender.
trace.who_recipient: Who can fix it: the recipient or their mail provider.
trace.who_us: Who can fix it: the Mailfilter administrator.
trace.who_nobody: Usually solves itself: Mailfilter keeps trying.
trace.verdict_delivered: Every recipient's mail server accepted the message.
trace.verdict_queued: Mailfilter is still processing this message.
trace.verdict_deferred: Mailfilter keeps trying for up to 5 days.
trace.verdict_quarantined: Held because it looks like spam or is dangerous. Release it if it is good mail.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.sub: Mail that looks like spam or is dangerous is held here. Release what is good, block what is not; the spam filter learns from every choice.
quarantine.empty: Quarantine is empty. Nothing is waiting for you.
quarantine.teach_hint: Releasing teaches "this is good mail", blocking teaches "this is spam".
quarantine.released: Released; the message is being delivered.
quarantine.learned: The spam filter learned from it.
quarantine.content_hint: Shown as plain text: links and images are not loaded, so viewing is safe.
quarantine.virus_warning: This message contains a virus. Only an administrator can release it.
quarantine.virus_warning_admin: This message contains a virus. Only release it if you are sure it is a false alarm.
quarantine.queue_unavailable: Mailfilter cannot reach the mail queue right now, so this list may include messages that were already handled.

symbols.R_SPF_FAIL: Sending server not allowed by SPF
symbols.DBL_SPAM: Link to a known spam domain

gateway.apply_failed: Not saved: the mail server check "{{step}}" failed, so nothing was changed.
gateway.applied: Saved and active on the mail server
gateway.last_ok: Mail server configuration is up to date (last change {{at}}).
gateway.last_failed: The last change on {{at}} was refused by the mail server; the previous configuration is still active.
gateway.never_applied: The configuration has not been written from the web interface yet.

domains.title: Domains
domains.sub: Domains the Mailfilter accepts mail for, and the mail server that receives the clean mail.
domains.sub_customer: Your domains and where their mail is delivered.
domains.empty: No domains yet. Add the first domain to start filtering.
domains.name: Domain
domains.not_configured_hint: This domain exists for users, but mail for it is not accepted yet. Enter its mail server to start.
domains.destinations_hint: Clean mail goes to the main server; backup servers are used when it cannot be reached.
domains.mx_hint: Look up the MX records of this host name instead of connecting to it directly.
domains.tls_hint: Required: never deliver without TLS. Verified: also check the certificate.
domains.verify_hint: Ask the mail server before accepting a message, so mail for unknown addresses is refused at the door (no backscatter).
domains.concurrency_hint: How many messages are delivered at the same time. Empty: default.
domains.rate_delay_hint: For mail servers that cannot keep up. Delivers one message at a time.
domains.outbound_hint: Mail sent out from this domain via the Mailfilter. Empty: the default from Throttling.
domains.enabled: Accept and deliver mail for this domain
domains.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}}? Mail for this domain is refused from then on.
domains.tls_sub: Require TLS for specific receiving domains
domains.tls_empty: No rules; encryption is used when available.

relay.title: Relay access
relay.sub: Servers (for example web servers) that may send mail out through the Mailfilter. Their mail is still checked for spam and viruses.
relay.sub_customer: Your servers that may send mail out through the Mailfilter.
relay.hint: Use one IP address for one server, or a network such as 203.0.113.0/28. IPv4 and IPv6 both work.
relay.confirm_broad: Yes, this large network is really ours
relay.ports_sub: Extra ports next to 587 and 465, e.g. for old software

throttling.title: Throttling
throttling.sub: Limits for mail going out through the Mailfilter, so one hacked web server or account cannot send thousands of spam messages.
throttling.defaults_sub: Apply unless a domain has its own limit
throttling.relay_ip_per_minute_hint: Messages one relay IP may send per minute.
throttling.relay_ip_per_hour_hint: Messages one relay IP may send per hour.
throttling.domain_per_hour_hint: Set a different limit per domain under Domains.
throttling.domain_per_day_hint: Set a different limit per domain under Domains.
throttling.user_per_hour_hint: Messages one SMTP login may send per hour.
throttling.concurrency_hint: Default for each domain's own delivery queue.
throttling.destinations_sub: Big providers block senders that go too fast
throttling.domain_limits_hint: Limits for your own domains are set per domain under Domains.
